title: Are these safe for cats?
technique: The Dip (H174) as a grey 25 s blockout (@Video1): cuts, shot sizes, camera moves and pacing only; the flip is written in words at its 9-11 s flight.
story: White pillar candles everywhere: a cat lady is about to buy the amber Fig & Cedar candle, scrolling its page up and down.
Inner voice, lips closed, the camera circling her: “Are these safe for cats?”
She finds nothing, gets annoyed, closes the site: “I guess we'll never know.”
The camera flips down to the owner, her sales on her laptop: “Wow, Fig and Cedar totally failed.”
“Looks like no one's interested in Fig and Cedar.” She clicks X and deletes it from her site.
She blows out the jar as Scout says: “Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy.” Clean end screen: “Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.”
